title: Realization preserves the finite root scalar extension on every pure tensor
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n≥0 with finite residue quotient R=O_E/l^(n+1), B=ULift R, and T a scheme. Use the actual root module and balanced fixed-scalar root tensor [def-pur-finite-root-pro-tensor] and the realization and intrinsic finite-line definitions [def-sp-p1-level-words]. There is a unique isomorphism from realization of finiteRootProTensor B l^(n+1) T to finiteLine l E T n whose value on the realization unit of every generator a⊗z over every pro-etale test W is tateFiniteTensor of the constant scalar section a and the same root z in μ_(l^(n+1))(W). No invertibility assumption on l on T is imposed.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite coefficient identification before the system splitting

proof.text: The associated-module sheafification adjunction identifies maps out of the realization of a fixed-scalar sheaf with fixed-scalar maps into scalar restriction of an intrinsic module. Compose with proLineHomEquiv to obtain a natural Hom-equivalence from the realized finite root tensor to additive maps from the actual finite roots sheaf.

Use finiteTateLine_universal for the intrinsic finite line. The two natural Hom-equivalences give maps in both directions; naturality for composition and the two inverse-equivalence identities prove that they are mutually inverse.

At a=1, proLineHomEquiv_generator and the realization unit give the root-section formula. proGenerator_smul and linearity of the realization unit and of the resulting map give the formula for every a. Injectivity of the Hom-equivalence and equality on roots prove uniqueness.

theorem finiteP1_intrinsic_root_tensor (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃! e : (realization l E n T).obj
        (Scheme.finiteRootProTensor (levelRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) (levelAnnihilates l E n) T) ≅
      finiteLine l E T n,
      ∀ (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : levelRing l E n)
        (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf T (l ^ (n + 1))).obj.obj W),
        e.hom.val.app W
          (Scheme.sfIntrinsicRealizationUnit T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) _ W
            (Scheme.finiteRootProGenerator (levelRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
              (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) (levelAnnihilates l E n) T W a z)) =
          Scheme.tateFiniteTensor T l (levelRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n) W.unop
            ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
              ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of (levelRing l E n)))).app W a) z
